title: Seal a mouse ventilated cage and dock it in its rack bay so both air valves connect
instruction: Seal the mouse cage and dock it in the empty bay of the ventilated rack so it is connected to the rack's air supply, then move both arms clear of the cage and rack.
context: Done by: animal caretakers (O*NET 39-2021.00; 266,910 US workers, BLS OEWS 2025), who clean and refill cages and return them to housing racks daily. In an individually ventilated cage (IVC) system every cage is closed by its filter top and slid along rack runners until the rack's air nozzles push open the cage's spring-closed inlet and outlet valves (US 4,343,261; US 5,044,316; rat IVC study PubMed 24602544: valves open only when docked correctly, inlet left, outlet right). The filter top seals by a radial silicone gasket with no latches (maker spec sheet). A top left off or out of register leaks; a cage left short of the nozzles gets no air. The top goes on before docking: on this bench a straight-down grip over a docked cage is 224-304 mm out of the arms' reach. The instruction names only the end state.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (+x forward, +y left), heights above the table. Mat, fixed: silicone bench mat 40.0 x 26.0 x 0.2 cm centred at (20.0, 0.0). Mouse cage, loose, 620 g: polycarbonate IVC cage base 39.1 x 19.9 x 16.0 cm on the mat at (21.0, 0.0), front (+x) toward the rack; side flanges 12.5 to 13.5 cm high overhang the 14.8 cm wide tub (mouth 36.8 x 14.0 cm); grip rails in the side-handle cutouts 13.5 to 15.6 cm high. Filter top, loose, 120 g: clear polycarbonate top 37.6 x 16.4 x 2.5 cm, lying flat (skirt down) on the bench beside the cage, centred at (24.5, 21.5). Underneath, a plug skirt carrying the radial silicone gasket fits 1 mm inside the tub mouth, with a chamfered lead-in (6 mm on the sides, 13 mm at the ends); on top, a 7.0 x 8.0 cm grip spine between two side-handle pockets, a 8.8 x 8.0 cm bottle bay and a filter sheet. Set on the tub it rests on the flange in register. Air valves: two spring-closed pistons (12 x 12 mm, protruding 1.0 cm from the cage front at y +-5.0 cm, 15.0 cm cage height; 8 mm travel, 100 N/m spring, 0.3 N seal friction). Water bottle, loose, 180 g: 5.5 x 5.5 x 12.9 cm 260 mL bottle upright in the cage's 6.0 x 6.0 cm front pocket (floor 3.3 cm). Rack bay, fixed, stainless, centred at (61.0, 0.0): bay 21.6 cm wide between side walls (inner faces y +-10.8 cm, 27.8 cm high, x 43.5 to 82.5), cell floor 0.4 cm high; two runner ledges 1.7 cm wide, 41.0 cm long (x 40.5 to 81.5), inner edges y +-9.1 cm, top 14.5 cm above the table; rear anti-tip rails x 71.0 to 82.5 at 17.2 cm; fixed rear stop face at x 80.8 (y +-3.0 cm); rear air plenum wall x 81.7 to 83.3; two silicone air nozzles (radius 0.5 cm) at y +5.0 cm (inlet) and -5.0 cm (outlet), 17.0 cm high, tips at x 81.1; header bar x 45.5 to 53.0 at 27.6 cm. Reach: a docked cage sits beyond the arms' reach for a straight-down grip at 10 to 20 cm height, so the top must be set on while the cage is on the bench. Bench props, visual only, not part of the task (no colliders, never touched), centre (x, y), footprint, height: disinfectant spray bottle, white plastic, (85.7, 25.0), 6.5 x 7.9 cm, 19.2 cm; disinfectant pump bottle, plastic, (75.1, 30.2), 8.5 x 8.3 cm, 17.1 cm; pair of light-duty nitrile gloves lying flat, (64.0, 47.1), 30 x 31 cm, 1.7 cm; box of disposable gloves, printed card, (55.0, -27.5), 11.8 x 17.8 cm, 5.7 cm; box of medical face masks, printed card, (74.0, -28.0), 10.0 x 18.0 cm, 7.1 cm; tub of cleaning wipes, plastic, (65.0, -48.0), 16.2 x 30.4 cm, 8.7 cm. Fixed layout every trial.
scoring: Final state only, from part poses and joint states every step. 0.15: cage hanging level on both runners (within 8 mm of runner height, tilt <= 5 degrees, >= 15 cm engaged). +0.20: filter top seated on the cage in register and level (every corner of its plug within 1.5 mm of its seated place). +0.25 per air valve pushed in >= 5 mm by its nozzle with the cage on the runners and home (nose within 3 mm of the stop). +0.15: all of that with the bottle upright in its pocket, cage, top and bottle at rest and both grippers >= 12 cm clear of cage and rack, held 3 s. Possible totals: 0, 0.15, 0.2, 0.35, 0.4, 0.6, 0.65, 0.85, 1.0. Cage tipped over 20 degrees or off the table: 0.
reset_notes: Cage on the bench mat in front of the rack, filter top lying flat on the bench beside it, both valves closed, bottle upright in its pocket, rack bay empty.
fidelity: Rigid parts at real IVC cage, top, bottle and rack dimensions. The gasket is a rigid plug skirt (1 mm radial play, chamfered lead-in, friction 0.5); real pull-off drag is read with a spring scale. Valve springs (100 N/m, 0.3 N seal friction) are declared, not measured; a push gauge on a piston reproduces them. No air flow, liquid or animal is simulated; valve travel is the connection proxy.
